slate_notes: Monday slate: 10 NBA, 7 NHL, MNF CIN @ WAS. 10 legs across 10 different games (NHL 5, NBA 4, NFL 1), 8 overs and 2 unders. Every leg is a per-book devig median at the exact line with 4-6 books (P1), and unders are shaded -3. Priced 9:51-9:53 AM ET. Skipped for cooldown/role: Okoro (misses Nov 20 and Nov 22), SGA (out), Jaylon Tyson (out), Panarin (DTD), Wembanyama U3.5 ast (DTD; Harper out = role expansion), Diabate/Clingan assist unders (recent teammate outs / recent overs), CIN WR unders (Iosivas IR = role expansion). Confirm each line in the app and skip Goblin/Demon lines.
